unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፱ — Meraf 9: Grand Master of ደ and ጀ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ደ and ጀ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የደ እና የጀ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: DEBTER
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'DEBTER' (Notebook) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ደብተር
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Notebook' (Debter). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ብተር.
games.tips_en: The full word is ደብተር (pronounced Deb-ter).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ደብተር
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Notebook (Debter)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ደ', then 6th form 'ብ', first form 'ተ', and end with 'ር'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: JELBA
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'JELBA' (Boat) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ጅ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'J' sound of the ጀ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ደወል
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Bell (Dewel)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ደ', followed by 'ወ', and end with 'ል'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: DEWEL
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'DEWEL' (Bell) with the correct Amharic word.
